boot.failedHint: Your data hasn't been changed. Try again, and if the problem continues, note the message below.
boot.notInDesktop: TaskFlow is running in a browser tab. Start it with "npm run tauri dev" so it can reach the local database.

placeholder.title: {{page}} isn't built yet
placeholder.body: This view is planned for Phase {{phase}}: {{scope}}. Nothing here is simulated, so it will stay empty until then.

tasks.title: Title
tasks.notesPlaceholder: Working notes, links, anything to keep with the task

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.body: Tasks you create appear here. Start with whatever is on your mind.
empty.filteredBody: Try removing a filter or searching for something else.

drawer.heading: Task
drawer.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted. Deleted tasks keep their history and can be restored right after deleting.

time.title: Time
time.inProgressHint: How long the task has sat in the In progress status across {{count}} stretch(es). This measures status duration, not time actually worked.
time.noSessions: No work tracked yet. Start the timer when you begin working.
time.trackedHint: Time you actively tracked with the timer. Pauses are excluded.
time.closedHint: Reopen the task to track more time.
time.otherTask: Timer is running on “{{title}}”. Starting here stops that one.

actions.deleteConfirmBody: The task and its subtasks move out of your lists. Their history is kept, and you can restore the task from the notification that follows.

activity.title: Activity
activity.notePlaceholder: Add a note to the timeline
activity.empty: Nothing has happened yet. Changes to tasks, projects and categories are recorded here automatically.
activity.end: That's the beginning of your history.

events.due_changed: changed the due date from {{from}} to {{to}}
events.work_session_logged_switched: tracked {{duration}} of work (timer moved to another task)
events.work_session_logged_task_closed: tracked {{duration}} of work (timer stopped when the task was closed)
events.work_session_logged_task_deleted: tracked {{duration}} of work (timer stopped when the task was deleted)

projects.name: Name

empty.title: No projects yet
empty.body: Group related tasks into a project to see their progress together. Tasks can also stay standalone.

projects.archiveHint: Archived projects leave your lists but keep their tasks and history.
projects.deleteConfirmBody: Its {{count}} task(s) are kept and become standalone. Each task's history records the change. Consider archiving instead if you just want it out of the way.
projects.notFound: This project isn't available. It may have been deleted.

empty.title: No categories yet
empty.body: Categories describe what kind of task something is, like Errands, Health or Admin. Add one below.

categories.deleteConfirmBody: It is removed from {{count}} task(s). The tasks themselves are kept, and each one's history records the change.

search.placeholder: Type a command or search tasks, projects and notes
search.hint: Type to search. Matches titles, descriptions, notes and timeline notes.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.accentHint: Used for selection, focus and primary actions.
appearance.densityHint: Compact fits more rows on screen.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.collapsedHint: Show icons only. Toggle any time with Ctrl+B.

later.title: More settings
later.body: Backups and data export are added in Phase 7. Dashboard widgets are customized on the Dashboard itself.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.weekStartHint: Used by the calendar, week groupings and weekly statistics.

windows.title: Windows
windows.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when closed
windows.closeToTrayHint: The close button hides TaskFlow to the system tray so reminders and timers keep working. Quit from the tray menu.
windows.startupHint: Opens TaskFlow in the tray when you sign in.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.enabledHint: Windows notifications for the reminders below. Each one is shown only once.
notifications.remindersHint: For tasks that have a due time.
notifications.overdueHint: Once, when a task passes its due date or time. Several at once are combined.
notifications.digestHint: One notification a day listing what is due and overdue, only when there is something.
notifications.testHint: Check that Windows shows TaskFlow notifications (Focus Assist can hide them).
notifications.testBody: You'll see reminders like this one.
notifications.blocked: Windows didn't allow the notification. Check Settings → System → Notifications.

quickAdd.placeholder: Add a task — try “Call dentist tomorrow 9am !high #health @home”
quickAdd.label: Quick add a task
quickAdd.hint: Enter to add · dates: today, tomorrow, mon–sun, +3d · !high · @project · #category

today.emptyBody: Tasks due today and anything overdue gather here. Add one below, or give an existing task today's date.

upcoming.emptyBody: Tasks with a future due date appear here, grouped by day.

overdue.emptyBody: No open task is past its due date.

inProgress.emptyBody: Move a task to In progress when you start it. Its time in that status is measured automatically.

completed.emptyBody: Completed tasks are listed here by the day you finished them.

board.dragHint: Drag cards between columns to change their status. Space picks up a focused card; arrows move it.

calendar.unscheduledHint: Open tasks without a due date. Open one and set a date to place it on the calendar.
calendar.unscheduledEmpty: Every open task has a date.

timeline.empty: No tasks are due, completed or in progress in this period.
timeline.legendSpan: Bar: from creation (or start) to due date or completion
timeline.undated: Tasks without a due date only appear here while in progress. See All tasks for the rest.

dashboard.customizeHint: Show, hide and reorder widgets. Drag a card or use the arrows.

stats.chartLabel: Tasks completed per day, last {{days}} days
stats.chartNote: Counts each task once per day it was completed.

empty.upcoming: No deadlines in the next 7 days.

kpi.leadHint: Creation to first completion, for {{count}} task(s) first completed in this period.
kpi.inProgressHint: Status duration: how long completed tasks sat in In progress ({{count}} task(s) that were ever started). It is not time spent working.
kpi.trackedHint: Time recorded with the work timer in this period. Pauses are excluded.

charts.trendNote: Each task counts once per period, however many times it was completed.
charts.trackedNote: From the manual timer only. Status duration is reported separately above.
charts.priorityNote: Open tasks now, and tasks completed in this period.

measures.title: Two different measures of time
measures.status: Time in progress is measured automatically from status changes. A task left In progress overnight accumulates time even though nobody worked on it.
measures.tracked: Tracked work only counts time you recorded with the timer. Use it when you want to know actual effort.

projects.name: Project
projects.empty: No project activity in this period.
